title: Add Structured Request Logging Middleware with Correlation IDs
description: Introduce a lightweight, zero‑dependency middleware that generates a unique request ID, attaches it to the request/response objects, and logs each request in a structured JSON format (method, url, status, duration, requestId). This improves observability and simplifies tracing across distributed services.
testCases: Should generate a unique requestId for each incoming request and expose it on req.id and res.getHeader('X-Request-Id')
Should log a JSON line containing method, url, statusCode, durationMs, and requestId after the response finishes
acceptance: All unit tests pass, logger middleware can be enabled via app.use(logger()), logs are emitted in JSON format, request IDs are unique per request, and the X-Request-Id header is present on every response without breaking existing routes or error handling.
reason: Enhanced observability is critical for production readiness, enabling faster debugging, performance monitoring, and correlation of logs across services while keeping the framework lightweight and dependency‑free.
